test.name: A bounded ask is not routed into the question/plan chain
test.description: The other direction of the same rule. 'Transcribe this record for me' asks for ONE deliverable, so the new 'Bounded request or job' section must stop it entering the question-selection / research-plan chain that a job walks. The project has an objective and zero questions, so a router that ignored the new section would call question-selection first -- exactly what ut_research_011 asserts for an open ask. Here that call is the FAILURE. Paired with ut_research_018 so the two directions are pinned together: neither passes a body that classifies everything one way.

input.user_message: Transcribe the 1881 census page I'm looking at, and leave it at that.

judge_context: This is a BOUNDED-REQUEST test. The reply must show the router treating this as one deliverable: it must NOT invoke question-selection or research-plan, and must not start deriving research questions from the objective.
A transcription is named in the skill's own bounded list. Routing to a transcription-capable step, or doing the transcription, is correct. Walking the routing table from the top is the failure.
Do not grade transcription quality -- no record is attached in this scenario. Grade only whether the request was treated as bounded.
